title: More than the Quantity: The Value of Editorial Reviews for a User-Generated Content Platform
near_miss_reason: Age FE in every column: all specifications (static er, lag_er, and the pre6-post6 event studies) add i.relative_month alongside i.month and business FE. relative_month is months since the restaurant's first month on the platform, defined for never-treated businesses as well (it is not event time; in the shipped panel relative_month - (month - adoption month) averages 5.7 for treated rows), so it is an additional non-redundant additive FE (PROTOCOL 5b: age FE make a column ineligible). The shipped data are also synthetic.
eligible_reason: Staggered binary design: er = 1 from the month a restaurant receives its first editorial review (absorbing), never-reviewed restaurants as controls, business FE and calendar-month FE (areg ..., absorb(business_id) i.month). Every column also includes i.relative_month (business-age FE), so no reported column qualifies. Tables 8-9 add time-varying reviewer controls (prior_vol, prior_rate, experience) and Table 11 uses xtnbreg (nonlinear).
design_notes: ER.do (Stata areg). Monthly DV.dta (synthetic, 3,326 businesses x 28 months, 28,698 rows): log_volume, rating, log_length; er; lag_er; pre6..pre2, post0..post6 (pre1 omitted). Table 5 (README mapping: Monthly DV and Review Level): static er and event studies; Table 6: lag_er; Table 11: xtnbreg volume/length (nonlinear) and review-level rating/length. Review Level.dta: topic1-5, positive/neutral/negative sentiment, smog, length1-5 on er or the event-time dummies (Tables 7 and 10). Review Mechanism.dta (Table 8): similarity outcomes with prior_vol prior_rate controls. Reviewer Mechanism.dta (Table 9): reviewer FE plus i.business_id, experience, prior_vol, prior_rate.
estimators_reported: twfe_static_with_age_fe (areg, business FE + month FE + relative_month FE)
